scholarships.title: University-funded doctoral researcher positions (University of Helsinki Doctoral School)

existing.description: The University of Helsinki Doctoral School provides annual funding for full-time doctoral researcher positions across all of the University's doctoral programmes. Holders are university employees and are expected to complete a doctoral degree within four years. There is one application period each year; the 2026 period ran from 24 August to 7 September 2026, with decisions notified to applicants by the end of December 2026. Detailed general and programme-specific application instructions are published in the University's Studies Service.
eligibility: Qualifying Master's degree for doctoral studies
Admission to one of the University of Helsinki's doctoral programmes selected in the application form
existing.eligibility_summary: Applicants who hold a qualifying Master's degree and are admitted to one of the University of Helsinki's doctoral programmes. The annual call covers every doctoral programme, so candidates must select the doctoral programme matching their research area.
benefits: Salary as a full-time university-employed doctoral researcher
coverage: Salary as a full-time university-employed doctoral researcher
application_method: Submit the application through the University of Helsinki Studies Service recruitment system
Choose a doctoral programme from the drop-down menu at the top of the application page
Follow both the general and the doctoral-programme-specific instructions
existing.selection_notes: Positions are allocated per doctoral programme; the University publishes a list of awarded positions.
existing.best_fit: Graduates seeking a salaried PhD at the University of Helsinki in any of its doctoral programmes.
existing.notes: General questions about the application go to the Studies Service; questions about research plans and supervisors should be directed to the relevant doctoral programme.
existing.duration: Four years, full-time work, doctoral degree to be completed within four years
existing.application_period: One annual application period covering all of the University's doctoral programmes; the 2026 period ran 24 August - 7 September 2026
existing.deadline_display: "The next application period for salaried positions is August 24 - September 7, 2026." The 2026 window closed on 7 September 2026 and the annual cycle repeats, but no date for the next period is published.
